tex_content.html:
Corollary
[Normal Bundle to a Pseudo-Riemannian Submanifold]

↗ def:pseudo-riemannian-metric ↗ def:pseudo-normal-space ↗ prop:pseudo-riemannian-adapted-frame ↗ lem:pseudo-normal-space-frame ↗ lem:local-frame-criterion-for-subbundles ↗ prop:existence-riemannian-metric

1. ch2:2.73

For an embedded or immersed pseudo-Riemannian or Riemannian submanifold $F:M^n\to \bar M^m$, the normal spaces form a smooth rank-$(m-n)$ vector subbundle of $F^*T\bar M$, the normal bundle.
Proof

↗ def:pseudo-normal-space ↗ lem:pseudo-normal-space-frame ↗ lem:local-frame-criterion-for-subbundles ↗ prop:existence-riemannian-metric \sketch Choose an auxiliary Riemannian metric on $\bar M$ by Proposition 2; Lemma 5 makes $F^*T\bar M$ a Riemannian vector bundle. Lemma 17 supplies smooth local bases of $N_xM$, so Lemma lem:local-frame-criterion-for-subbundles yields the rank-$(m-n)$ subbundle. The auxiliary metric does not alter the normal spaces defined by $\bar g$.

□
